data.content_ref: inline:SRC_009 reduces to SRC_010: the sector-count argument (at most 2n regions through a point) depends on the diameter framing that each cut splits exactly 2 existing slices. The sector bound and the incremental-splitting recurrence are dual descriptions of the same concurrency mechanism. This is refuted if the diameter framing alone fails to prove the 2n ceiling without the sector argument.
